title: [LOGGED OUT] Phone Store shows a sideways tab bar and 2 cards per row
reason: All answers match. Phone emulation via Chrome mobileEmulation 390x844 (no screen recording).

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store and wait until loaded
steps.saw: Store page loaded, cookie banner shown.

steps.text: If a cookie banner is shown, click Dismiss
If an Add It to Home Screen banner is shown, close it with its X
steps.saw: Closed with Close pwa banner X.

steps.text: Scroll down to the Store heading
steps.saw: Store heading (red ribbon) and the tab bar are at the top of the screen.

steps.text: Is the tab bar one row that can be scrolled sideways?
steps.saw: Single row: Free wares, Battle Passes, Gifts to friends, Licenses, then a cut-off tab at the right edge; container scrollWidth 1003 vs clientWidth 368 (overflow-x scroll).

steps.text: Scroll down to the Gold heading
steps.saw: Gold heading shown below the sticky tab bar.

steps.text: Are the gold cards shown 2 per row?
steps.saw: Small pile of gold and Piggy bank of gold side by side, Carpetbag of gold and Goblet of gold in the next row.

steps.text: Does the page fit the screen width, with no horizontal scroll?
